examples.name: Required
examples.summary: A required Textarea inside a Field: the label carries the Required marker and the border stays neutral until the field is invalid.

examples.name: Readonly
examples.summary: A read-only certificate keeps the filled look, drops the hover border and reads in the code face (`monospace`); the field description says why the value cannot change.

examples.name: Monospace
examples.summary: A zone-file paste box: `monospace` draws the records in the code face, so columns and characters read as code; `:spellcheck="false"` keeps the browser from flagging record names.

examples.name: AutoResize
examples.summary: A question box that starts at one line and grows with the text up to six lines, then scrolls: `auto-resize` with `:min-rows` and `:max-rows`.

examples.name: Resizable
examples.summary: The `resize` prop on each axis: `vertical` (the default), `horizontal`, `both` and `none`.
